data.one_liner: Command-line tool to find, delete, and sort unused translations in .arb files.
data.what_it_does: Searches Dart files using AST parsing to detect key usage and automatically cleans, sorts, or lists unused translation keys across all languages in .arb files. Designed for flutter_localizations.
use_when: You use flutter_localizations with .arb files and want to remove dead or unused translation keys.
You want to sort translation keys alphabetically.
You want to enforce unused translation checks in a CI pipeline.
avoid_when: Your project uses localization formats other than .arb files, such as JSON or YAML.
You need automated runtime localization loading rather than a build-time/dev-time cleanup utility.
strengths: AST-based detection drastically reduces false positives compared to raw regex searches.
Supports multiple commands including cleaning, listing unused terms, and sorting translations.
Can be easily integrated into CI workflows with the abort flag.
weaknesses: Limited exclusively to .arb files and flutter_localizations.
Does not support other localization formats like JSON or YAML.
data.setup_notes: Add translations_cleaner as a dev dependency in your pubspec.yaml and run via dart run or flutter pub run.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub add --dev translations_cleaner
dart run translations_cleaner clean-translations
